extractions.quote: Based on the above, stiff person syndrome was assumed. Serum GAD test was negative. extractions.value: Patient had a history of high blood pressure, hypercholesterinaemia, nephrolithiasis, and gastroesophageal reflux disease. Routine laboratory studies showed elevated creatine kinase (650 U/l). Initial MRI of thoracolumbar spine showed multiple disc herniations with root compression, leading to an unnecessary discectomy. The patient was bedridden before cancer treatment; after breast surgery and aromatase-inhibiting therapy, she improved to using a rollator walker and the baclofen pump was removed 18 months after breast surgery.
